items.title: Google Cloud Launches AI-powered Agents to Simplify Database Lifecycle Management
items.blurb: Google Cloud has introduced AI-powered Database Operations Agents, featuring an Onboarding Agent that streamlines database setup and an Observability Agent that helps automate troubleshooting, performance optimization, and tuning.

items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Garhwal
items.blurb: Editors: Arsh Sharma, Christopher Tineo, Kirti Goyal, Sophia Ugochukwu, Swathi Rao, Troy Connor Similar to previous releases, the release of Kubernetes v1.37 introduces new Stable, Beta, and Alpha features.

items.title: Stream HCP Vault Dedicated audit logs to Microsoft Sentinel
items.blurb: HCP Vault Dedicated has no native Microsoft Sentinel connector. Deploy a Terraform-managed pipeline that streams audit logs into Azure Log Analytics and Microsoft Sentinel.

items.title: Streamline identity lifecycle management on HCP with SCIM provisioning
items.blurb: New HCP SCIM provisioning automates user and group lifecycle management from your identity provider to reduce admin overhead and improve secure, consistent access.

items.title: GitHub confirms Actions outage caused by database issue
items.blurb: If your GitHub Actions jobs are stuck in "Queued" or waiting for a runner, GitHub has now confirmed there is an incident. GitHub says they identified an issue with a database primary and are failing over to a replica.
